element: Hero banner 'Boo-nanza ends in 04:59:59' restarting on reload
detectionNote: Server HTML always shows 04:59:59 and the client ticks down from 17999 s. The restart shows on any reload made more than 1 s after the first load. One snapshot gives a text match only.

element: 'Black Friday of the Dead ends at midnight' text, rolling to the next midnight daily
detectionNote: Static string. It never rolls inside a snapshot, so a detector separates it from home-fixed-date-sale only by wording ('midnight' with no calendar date). Text only.

element: 'Winter sale ends 28 Feb 2027, 23:59 UTC' fixed date, same on reload
detectionNote: Honest twin. A real calendar date, identical on every load and later than DEMO_VALID_UNTIL (2027-01-31). A detector must not flag it.

element: Cookie banner: big filled 'Accept all', 11px grey link 'options', no reject on layer 1
detectionNote: Accept all is 20px and weight 700 on a filled button. The 'options' link is 11px #9a9a9a (about 2.7:1 on #fff9ee). No reject control on this layer.

element: Cookie banner: 'Reject' as ghost button, contrast about 2:1, 60% opacity
detectionNote: Reject is 14px #b3b3b3 (about 2.0:1 on #fff9ee) at opacity 0.6, next to a large filled Accept all.

element: Cookie banner: equal-size, equal-style Accept and Reject
detectionNote: Honest twin. Accept all and Reject all carry identical inline styles. At 390x844 both must lie fully inside the viewport (checked by the later capture spec).

element: 'Only 2 left!' random on reload
detectionNote: The value changes per load and is never 3 (it is one of 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9). Two loads match with probability 1/7, so a detector needs at least 3 samples.

element: '14 people are viewing this' random
detectionNote: The value changes per load between 8 and 48. Two loads match with probability 1/41, so use at least 3 samples.

element: 'Selling fast' badge on the product page, no number
detectionNote: An unquantified 'Selling fast' badge on the product page only, not on the grid. Text only, so low confidence.

element: Tiny grey 'Almost gone' in a data-attribute driven span, 10px
detectionNote: 'Almost gone' at 10px #9a9a9a, also held in a data-stock-label attribute.

element: '3 left' from a real inventory field that drops when added to cart
detectionNote: Honest twin. '3 left' comes from a fixed inventory constant and is identical on every load. The per-load stock never equals 3, so values across loads separate the twins. One snapshot separates them only by wording.

element: Rotating toast 'Morgan from Ohio just bought...'
detectionNote: A role=status toast. The first message is the same on every load and four messages rotate every 6000 ms, so seeing the rotation needs a wait of at least 6 s.

element: Upsell modal: large 'Add crypt keeper bundle', close 'x' 8px pale grey
detectionNote: The close 'x' is 8px #cfc6bc and renders about 3x8 px (about 1.6:1). The bundle button is 20px, weight 700 and full width.

element: Pre-checked 'Add Raven Shipping Protection +$4.99'
detectionNote: Checkbox with the checked attribute and +$4.99 in its label.

element: Pre-selected 'Gold Extended Curse Warranty' in a radio group, not the cheapest
detectionNote: The Gold radio (+$9.00) is checked while None ($0.00) and Silver (+$3.00) are cheaper. A detector must parse the prices.

element: role=switch 'Priority coffin packaging' on by default, styled like a toggle
detectionNote: A role=switch button with aria-checked=true in the server HTML. A visitor can switch it off; a snapshot sees the initial state.

element: Unchecked optional 'Gift wrap +$2'
detectionNote: Honest twin. Optional gift wrap, unchecked.

element: Cheapest shipping radio preselected
detectionNote: Honest twin. The checked radio is the cheapest of three ($4.00). It has the same shape as the warranty entry, so a detector must compare prices.

element: 'Insurance' line item appears after only 'add to cart'
detectionNote: Not scored: one static snapshot cannot show sneak-into-basket, because the row looks like any other cart row. The later boo-tique-flows spec makes the add-to-cart step real.

element: Newsletter box pre-checked
detectionNote: Checkbox with the checked attribute.

element: Step 1 total $40; step 3 adds 'handling $6.99' and 'haunting fee $3'
detectionNote: Not scored: drip pricing needs the cart and the checkout side by side, which one snapshot cannot give. The later boo-tique-flows spec makes it real.

element: Shipping and tax shown from the cart and unchanged through checkout
detectionNote: Honest twin. Every row of the summary equals the cart summary. Scored only as no-flag: a static detector must return no finding. The cart comparison is a cross-page signal for the later flows spec.

element: 'Yes, give me 20% off!' vs 'No thanks, I hate saving money'
detectionNote: Confirmshaming wording on the decline button. The decline button has the same style as the accept button.

element: Decline text 'I'll pay full price like a mortal'
detectionNote: Confirmshaming wording on the decline button. The decline button has the same style as the accept button.

element: Decline text 'Maybe later, I don't need protection' in an insurance upsell
detectionNote: Confirmshaming wording on the decline button inside a protection upsell card. Same style as the accept button.

element: Plain 'No thanks' / 'Not now' decline
detectionNote: Honest twin. A plain 'No thanks' with a style equal to the accept button.

element: 'Join in 09:59 for 20% off' timer kept in sessionStorage, restarts after zero with the same offer
detectionNote: The timer lives in sessionStorage. It restarts with the same offer only after 10 minutes, or in a fresh browser context where it starts at 09:59 again. One snapshot gives a text match only.

element: Subscribe is 1 click; cancel needs 5 screens, retention offers, then a phone call
detectionNote: Not scored: the page shows only a call-us sentence, and a cancel maze needs a walk through screens that one snapshot cannot show. The later boo-tique-flows spec makes it real.

element: Second plan with a 1-click cancel
detectionNote: Honest twin. The Cancel plan button has the bt-button class, the same size and weight as the most prominent button on its card, and the card has no retention copy. A salience detector must not flag it.

element: Exit-intent newsletter modal with a preselected 'partners' checkbox
detectionNote: The partners checkbox has the checked attribute in the server HTML. The modal's own newsletter checkbox is unchecked.
